name: mast
description: Drive a MAST-controlled scanning tunneling microscope (Nanonis) from Claude Code: briefing, skill search, jobs with polling, raw data download, notes, operator requests and handover, over MAST's external agent API. Standard-library MCP server, no packages to install.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Python 3.10+ for the MCP server; no additional packages required. The public source package does not bundle Python. Use an installed interpreter, or MASTv2/pyruntime/python.exe from an existing full installation. On Windows use an explicit interpreter path.

mast_url.title: MAST address
mast_url.description: Root address of the MAST service. Same machine: http://127.0.0.1:7862. LAN mode uses https. Addresses of other machines are refused unless 'Allow a remote MAST' is on.

mast_user.title: MAST user (LAN mode)
mast_user.description: HTTP Basic user name of MAST's LAN access. Leave empty for a MAST on this machine.

mast_password.title: MAST password (LAN mode)
mast_password.description: HTTP Basic password for MAST LAN access. Marked sensitive and stored by the client; storage protection depends on platform. Leave empty for a local MAST service.

verify_tls.title: Verify TLS certificate
verify_tls.description: Turn off only for the instrument PC's self-signed certificate in LAN mode.

allow_remote.title: Allow a remote MAST
allow_remote.description: Allow a MAST address that is not this machine. Control is meant for this machine or a VPN; never expose MAST to the open internet.

actor.title: Actor name
actor.description: Name your actions are attributed to in MAST's records (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore).
